newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes firmer as funds flow in.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes firmer as funds flow in.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended firmer against its American counterpart on Monday, pushed by inflows of foreign funds for the stock market, dealers said.
The local dollar finished at T$27.489 against Saturday's T$27.494 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest T$122 million.
Dealers said only limited impact from Taiwan provincial governor James Soong's New Year's Eve resignation.
The Taiwan dollar faced appreciation pressure in the near term as year-end commercial demand for the U.S. dollar has come to an end, dealers said.
"The Taiwan dollar still has room to rise but many investors are waiting for the performance of overseas markets to set a direction," said one dealer.
A T$27.48-27.49 range was seen for Tuesday.
